thread:
Matt: ApexHealth returned the CAIQ. They want a short shared-responsibility table and canned replies for key management, data residency, and evidence. Can we draft and send today? cc @Erin @Julia

Erin: Yep. Quick question: wording for KMS/HSM ownership across Hosted / Dedicated / Private?

Julia: Suggested short phrasing: Hosted = Redwood-managed keys by default; customer-managed KMS supported as enterprise option. Dedicated = BYK supported (customer provides keys); we operate runtime. Private/on-prem = customer-managed KMS/HSM inside their network.

Sam: For the CAIQ key control question, keep it 2-3 sentences: who rotates keys, where rotation logs live, and who has access. Link to internal KMS guide when sending.

Matt: Can someone paste a tiny inline ownership matrix we can drop into the spreadsheet? They asked not to rely solely on external links.

Erin: Quick matrix below (keep it compact).

"Control area | Redwood responsibility | Customer responsibility
---|---|---
Key management (Hosted) | Default key storage & rotation (Redwood KMS); audit logs | Data classification; app-level keys; request key exports
Key management (Dedicated) | Enable BYK integration; runtime support | Provide & rotate KMS keys (Cloud KMS/HSM); manage network access
Key management (Private) | Operate deployment components; validate integrations | Full KMS/HSM ownership; rotate keys; manage HSM ACLs
Logging & Audit | Collect infra logs; provide SOC2 evidence exports | Retain application logs; configure SIEM forwarding
Data residency & Backups | Region pinning available for hosted; backup encryption | Provide regulatory constraints; approve physical locations
"

Julia: Also map to CAIQ control IDs when possible (e.g., CCM-09 -> key mgmt). Call out supported integrations: AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault, PKCS#11 HSMs.

Matt: They also want a one-line for vendor review evidence.

Sam: Draft evidence line: "Available on request: SOC2 Type II report, KMS configuration screenshots, key rotation logs, architecture diagram showing key boundaries, and controls mapping spreadsheet."

Erin: Canned shared-responsibility answer for CAIQ cell (short):

"Redwood Inference operates the inference runtime and underlying infrastructure. Customers are responsible for application-level data handling, tenant access controls, and management of customer-provided cryptographic keys for Dedicated and Private deployments. For Hosted deployments Redwood manages default encryption keys but can support customer-managed keys via enterprise agreements. See attached controls matrix for details and evidence options."

Julia: Add PII statement: "We do not use customer data to train models. PII handling follows customer configuration and retention settings; deletion/export APIs available."

infra-security-bot: Link added to internal review: https://internal.redwood.dev/security/vendor-reviews/apexhealth-2026 (sales+sec) :white_check_mark:

Matt: One last item 111 3 Pricing/POC: ApexHealth wants a Dedicated POC with BYK enabled for 2 weeks. Any setup fees or timeline constraints?

Sam: Typical timeline: 1 week infra + capacity prep, 2-3 days for KMS/HSM integration testing, then POC. Setup fee depends on reserved GPU footprint; I'll add estimates to the quote.

Erin: I'll paste the final CAIQ answers into the spreadsheet and ping Legal for the BYK addendum. Planning to send by EOD unless objections.

Matt: Sounds good. Thanks team ":thumbsup:"
